atoms.text:
Text 1:
Abigail and Charlotte have practised their duet for many weeks now. They are really excited to finally perform it at the school’s summer celebration. The song they want to sing is “Love is an Open Door” from Frozen. Abigail will sing Anna’s part while Charlotte does Hans’ part. Their parents will be relieved when they finally stop singing the same song all the time.

atoms.text:
Text 2:
Valerio was forced to present a song for his school’s summer celebration. The best one he found was “Under The Sea” from The Little Mermaid, since it’s a song from a well-known film. He is planning on dancing throughout the song. His outfit is already set as well. A Hawaiian shirt, a hat and some sunglasses should be all he needs.
